scripts.db:schema: set -a; [ ! -f .env.local ] || . ./.env.local; set +a; PSQL_BIN="$(which -a psql | grep -v '/node_modules/' | head -n 1)"; "$PSQL_BIN" "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f database/schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: set -a; [ ! -f .env.local ] || . ./.env.local; set +a; PSQL_BIN="$(which -a psql | grep -v '/node_modules/' | head -n 1)"; "$PSQL_BIN" "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f database/seed.sql
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:schema && npm run db:seed
